articles.summary: MYQORZO is the Only Cardiac Myosin Inhibitor with Data in Its U.S. Label Comparing Its Effectiveness to the Beta Blocker Metoprolol SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Cytokinetics, Incorporated (Nasdaq: CYTK) today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved a supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) updating the U.S. Prescribing Information for MYQORZO ® (aficamten) to include data from MAPLE-HCM, the Phase 3 trial comparing MYQORZO and the standard-of-care beta-blocker metoprolol, each as monotherapy, in adults with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM). MYQORZO is indicated for the treatment of adults with symptomatic oHCM to improve functional capacity and symptoms. “People living with HCM deserve treatment decisions grounded in rigorous evidence.
